mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.payment_id AS paymentId, r.rental_date AS rentalDate, r.return_date AS returnDate, r.total_price AS totalPrice, r.status AS status, m.model_name AS carName, m.model_brand AS brand, c.car_fuel AS fuel, p.parking_name AS parkingName FROM reservations r JOIN car c ON r.car_id = c.car_id JOIN model m ON c.model_id = m.model_id JOIN parking p ON c.rental_station = p.parking_id WHERE r.user_num = #{userNum} ORDER BY r.created_at desc;
